scientific_purpose: Check independent 2 vs4 fixed-cell head widths and hard vs fully differentiable source-conditioned soft routing on original authenticated FIT observations, exact 6800-byte FP32 recurrence, 95k-105k parameter and <=1% paired gap, exact source-available forward/backward gradient connection, source/labels leakage prevention and profiler budget before any training.

experimental_design.controls: 4h-hard forward and forecast exact original LATFUSE003 model, no changed stored checkpoints
experimental_design.common_loss: genuine FIT masked .8 Gaussian NLL+.2 MAE, .25 physical-source-distinct key hinge, .03 soft probability load balance. Future measured target used only after forecast. No fabricated facts.
experimental_design.hardware: CPU PyTorch graph 1 thread; source-only fixed station-hour origins, per-arm 2 seeds planned only after matched compute/params eligible
experimental_design.parity: All arms 95k-105k and <=1% params across registered shapes; FLOPs must be measured, not presumed equal or padded; if forward/backward/optimizer FULL FLOP >1% mismatch no fair comparative FIT promoted.
experimental_design.stop: No optimizer in this diagnostic. No source report 2015, no protected 2016-2017, no future target injected into model, no synthetic task capability assertion. Training requires separate frozen preregistration.
